name: jsonkit
description: Read and reshape one JSON document.
tokens: Every input is a string token. A schema describes the value one token must satisfy, and each token of a multiple option or a variadic argument satisfies it alone. A null schema means the accepted shape is unknown, not that every token is accepted. An example's command holds the tokens after the application name.

exitCodes.1: Expected action failure, internal failure, or invalid declarations
exitCodes.130: Cancelled by SIGINT or by a caller-supplied abort

encodings.json: The output is one JSON document. Unless the Command's view reshapes it, a value result is the value and a rows result is the array of its rows.
encodings.jsonl: Each line is one JSON document: one line per element when the printed value is an array, nothing for an empty array, and one line otherwise. Unless the view reshapes it, a rows result prints one line per row.

globals.name: file
globals.description: The document to read. Omit it to read piped text.

globals.name: manifest
globals.description: Print this command's manifest as JSON.

globals.name: explain
globals.description: Explain the selected command and exit.

command.name: get
command.description: Read one value at a path.
details: Quote a path that holds a shell metacharacter.
A path is a dot-separated walk from the root of the document.
